decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that directly supports the firm's stated direction and uses established salami capabilities, it remains a very attractive low-cost option to keep open.

The premium sharing snack is still close to the core salami business and a multi-variant line, so after another year it is more likely to be retained than abandoned unless sales have clearly disappointed.
This organic boiled sausage extends a familiar product type into the firm's strategic bio range, making it a relatively low-uncertainty option worth continuing for another year.
The organic thinly sliced chicken breast line fits the push into organic assortment and convenient cold cuts, and its multiple variants justify keeping the option open while demand further resolves.
The organic herb-coated salami is a more niche single-product extension, so its withdrawal risk is higher than the broader lines, but it still fits core competencies well enough to keep for now.
